WWE Sunday Night's Main Event Card Announced

WWE announced the final card for Sunday Night's Main Event, scheduled for September 6 at the State Farm Arena in Atlanta. The event is set to begin at 8 p.m. ET and will be available to watch on Peacock. Details regarding UK start times and free YouTube live streams were also provided.
